But we have no spectra provided. Perhaps we need to request spectra using tools: proton_nmr_spectra, carbon_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra, mass_spectrometry_spectra. We need to infer structure. Use minimal experiments. Likely need to get mass spec to get molecular weight, then NMR to deduce structure.

We can start by retrieving mass spectrum.
